## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION — Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND while HYG (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -0.27%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND signal rising credit pressure; VXX (1W: +0.41% | 1M: -4.47%) RECOVERY shows fear creeping in.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress signal (HYG/LQD direction) pointing tighter: HYG/LQD behavior consistent with increased risk premium. Fear is edging up: VXX (1W: +0.41% | 1M: -4.47%) RECOVERY, and SPY/TLT (Stocks vs Bonds 1W: -1.33% | 1M: +5.37%) CORRECTION shows short-term stocks vs bonds softness.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-tightening: TLT (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND with the yield backdrop mixed and Dollar Strength (Level: 28.6000 | 1W: +0.42% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND supporting slightly tighter conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Rotation into cyclicals/financials: XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND while XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth confirms Value/Cyclicals showing strength over Growth.

5. US vs Global?  
US broadly corrective: SPY (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION; China outperforms: FXI (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND and KWEB (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +14.26%) CORRECTION on 1W/1M divergence, EM mixed with EEM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -6.39%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Waning: Speculation Index (Level: 0.0981 | 1W: -5.49% | 1M: -8.44%) BELOW TREND; ARKK (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: +0.21% | 1M: -2.01%) RECOVERY show selective risk-taking; IBIT (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +9.70%) CORRECTION highlights longer-term crypto interest despite short-run pullback.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial/metal strength: CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and broad commodity indices showing 1M gains, while gold SLV/GLD bid — GLD (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND — signals risk-hedging alongside cyclical buying.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy holding up: XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: -1.22% | 1M: +16.33%) CORRECTION on 1W weakness but strong 1M; natural gas UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Breadth (10/11) and Financials strength (XLF 1W/1M positive) provide constructive backdrop; Divergence: Tech weakness (XLK BELOW TREND) versus broad sector gains is notable but not a core multi-ETF break across SPY/XLF/TLT set — treat as monitored sector rotation.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals/financials and commodities exposure (XLF, XLE, CPER showing strength) and reduce exposure to lagging Tech and semiconductors (XLK, SOXX BELOW TREND); bonds neutral-to-cautious given TLT BELOW TREND and mixed SPY/TLT signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND, Industrials (sector breadth +4.45% 1W) showing strength.  
BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND, Semiconductors SOXX (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -17.43%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper/Industrial CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and oil buckets with multi-week strength.  
BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND remains vulnerable.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~22 (watch for further fear pick-up), Credit spread / HYG-LQD ratio ~0.7442 (watch tightening/widening), SPY/TLT ~8.8250 (stocks vs bonds inflection), XLK/XLF ratio ~3.0643 (tech vs financials leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive but rising credit signals and creeping VXX keep risk elevated. Financials and Energy showing strength while Tech/semiconductors are the primary divergence to monitor.
